lastCompletedStory.title: Capture/confirm type in the /cam-spec grill (both command copies)

nextStoryContext: US-004 (planner carries type from the issue into the PRD, both planner agent copies) is next. The issue's optional top-level `type` field (feat|fix|chore|docs, set via US-002's `specifyIssueOnMain` + US-003's grill capture) needs to flow into the generated PRD so US-005 (composePrTitle) and US-006 (ship-pr label) have something to read. Check the planner agent copies (.claude/agents/*planner*.md and templates/agents/*planner*.md, or wherever /cam-plan's PRD-authoring instructions live) for how they currently read the issue JSON and where the PRD schema/prd.json shape would carry a `type` value (likely a top-level `type` key on the PRD itself, defaulting to 'feat' when the issue has none — the deferred default from US-002/US-003). Both command copies of /cam-spec are byte-identical after this story (re-verify with diff before assuming a single edit suffices, per the cam-dual-copy-is-per-file pattern).
